subject: HeliosPay privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & next steps
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
To: sophie.leclerc@heliospay.eu, privacy@heliospay.eu
Cc: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com, laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-04T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: HeliosPay privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & next steps

Hi Sophie / Helios team,

Thanks again for the demo today — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the privacy/compliance items we agreed to action: 

Summary of what we heard
- Data flows: HeliosPay will send transaction metadata and pseudonymized user IDs to Redwood for inference and embeddings.
- Primary legal posture: HeliosPay expects to be the Controller; Redwood will act as Processor for the service.
- Cross-border transfers: routing from EU customers to Redwood-hosted inference in US regions (customer-managed routing options discussed).
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 readiness documentation; Type II audit is scheduled for Q1 2027. We can share interim evidence.

Immediate asks / what we will send by end of day:
- Draft DPA (Redwood standard template) with the recommended SCC mapping attached (Redwood_DPA_Overview.pdf).
- A short SCC module recommendation note (attached: Redwood_SCC_Module_Matrix.docx) that maps HeliosPay -> Redwood as Controller->Processor (Module 2) and calls out an optional Processor-to-Processor sub-clause for certain third-party subprocessors.
- Vendor security questionnaire template (Helios_VSQ_Response_Template.xlsx) — we filled the security posture basics from today's call; would appreciate any clarifications on the outstanding items.

Questions for you (quick yes/no where possible):
1) Can you confirm HeliosPay is the Controller for the data we will process for the initial pilot?
2) Do you have a preferred SCC module variant? Our recommendation: Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) with a short subprocessor carve-out referencing Module 3 where subprocessors act as processors of HeliosPay data.
3) Target timeline: do you need the signed DPA + SCC in place before POC access, or will a DPA-signed commitment + SOC 2 evidence suffice for initial access?

Proposed owners & deadlines
- Redwood (Markus): send DPA + SCC recommendation + VSQ prefilled — EOD today (attached).
- HeliosPay (Sophie / Privacy): confirm controller role and SCC preference — by Tue 2026-12-08.
- Redwood Legal (Laura / David): stand by for any redlines from HeliosPay; we suggest DocuSign execution.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Overview.pdf; Redwood_SCC_Module_Matrix.docx; Helios_VSQ_Response_Template.xlsx

Thanks — will follow up after I get your confirmation on the three quick items above.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Leclerc <sophie.leclerc@heliospay.eu>
To: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
Cc: privacy@heliospay.eu, antoine@heliospay.eu
Date: 2026-12-04T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: HeliosPay privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & next steps

Hi Markus — thanks for the summary and for sending the attachments. Quick responses inline: 

- Confirmed: HeliosPay will be the Controller for data collected from our customers; Redwood will be a Processor for the services you provide.
- SCC preference: we generally default to the Commission's Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor). However, because we route some telemetry to analytics vendors (and Redwood may use subprocessors in the US), we would like your DPA to call out the Processor-to-Processor path for subprocessors when applicable (Module 3 language).
- Timeline: for the pilot we need an executed DPA + SCC in place before we provision full production credentials. For early sandbox access, a signed DPA with SOC 2 evidence and a subprocessor list will be sufficient.

Action items for you:
1) Please provide a DPA with Module 2 as the default and a short addendum referencing Module 3 for subprocessors.
2) Can you send interim SOC 2 readiness evidence and a current subprocessor list?
3) We'll review the VSQ you populated — I expect a few clarifying questions from our security team (Antoine copied).

We can aim to have legal review complete by 12/10 if we get the DPA and evidence this week.

Regards,
Sophie Leclerc
Head of Privacy & Compliance
HeliosPay

From: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, david.kim@redwood-inference.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-04T12:45:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: HeliosPay privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & next steps

LAURA / DAVID — forwarding Sophie’s reply. Key asks: executed DPA + Module 2 default, with Module 3 carve-out for subprocessors; SOC 2 interim evidence and subprocessor list for sandbox access.

Proposed legal approach (suggested):
- Send Redwood standard DPA but update the SCC mapping section to explicitly state: Controller (HeliosPay) -> Processor (Redwood) = Module 2.
- Add an appendix: "Subprocessor Transfers" that incorporates Module 3 language for cases where a Redwood subprocessor processes HeliosPay data and needs processor-to-processor coverage. Keep the appendix opt-in only for those subprocessors and require notice.
- For timing: offer immediate sandbox with signed DPA + SOC 2 readiness package + current subprocessor list; require full production provisioning after DocuSign-executed DPA with SCC annex.

David — can you draft the DPA language for the SCC annex and an appendix that is narrow (few paragraphs) rather than a full alternate module? We want to avoid unnecessary bilateral redlines.

Markus / I will prep the supporting materials and VSQ responses.

Thanks,
Monica

From: markus.klein@redwood-inference.com
To: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com, laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, david.kim@redwood-inference.com, sophie.leclerc@heliospay.eu
Cc: privacy@heliospay.eu
Date: 2026-12-06T14:32:00-05:00
Subject: Re: HeliosPay privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & next steps

Quick status update and owners after internal review: 

What we sent (attachments):
- Updated DPA draft (attached) that defaults to Module 2 (Controller->Processor) and contains a short "Subprocessor SCC" appendix referencing Module 3 where applicable.
- Filled VSQ template with answers we discussed; flagged three items that require HeliosPay clarification (see VSQ row comments).
- SOC 2 readiness packet (exported controls mapping) and current subprocessor list (S3, vectorstore, telemetry) — attached as part of the Redwood_DPA_Overview.pdf.

Owners / next steps: 
- Redwood Legal (David): finalize any minor edits to the DPA SCC appendix if HeliosPay redlines — target 12/07 for final draft.
- Redwood AE (Monica): confirm sandbox credential provisioning upon signed DPA + SOC evidence — target 12/07.
- HeliosPay (Sophie): review DPA + VSQ and confirm controller status & SCC acceptance by 12/10.

If HeliosPay confirms controller position and accepts Module 2 w/ appendix, we will route the DPA to DocuSign and provision sandbox access upon signature. If they request broader Module 3 conversion, we'll escalate to legal for a short negotiation (but propose we avoid wholesale Module swaps to reduce time to provision).

I'll hold a 15-min sync if anyone wants to review the SCC appendix text before we send to Sophie.

Thanks all — moving to execution.

Best,
Markus

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Overview.pdf; Helios_VSQ_Response_Template.xlsx; Redwood_SCC_Module_Matrix.docx
